Question: Determine whether the following two code snippets are semantic code clones.

Code 1: Python
```python
def sum_even_numbers(numbers):
    total = 0
    for n in numbers:
        if n % 2 == 0:
            total += n
    return total
```

Code 2: Java
```java
public static int sumEvenNumbers(int[] numbers) {
    int total = 0;
    int i = 0;

    while (i < numbers.length) {
        if (numbers[i] % 2 == 0) {
            total += numbers[i];
        }
        i++;
    }

    return total;
}
```
